headings.note: Use Tajawal for a modern, geometric Arabic feel. Use tight tracking even for Arabic.

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for Premium Gulf Market)
colors.note: Colors are customizable from admin, but this is the default premium theme.

marketing.hero: Asymmetric bento grid with an overlapping abstract graphic or laptop mockup. Use generous padding (py-24).
marketing.features: Bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12), wide gaps (gap-8), high visual tension.
marketing.templates_gallery: Grid of cards with hover lift (-translate-y-2) and subtle shadow. Masonry or varied heights.

dashboard.container: RTL-aware layout with sidebar on the RIGHT (in RTL mode, start is right).
dashboard.sidebar: w-64 fixed, bg-white border-e border-slate-200. Use logical classes like 'border-e'.
dashboard.content: Dense grid layout (gap-6) for data and metrics. Cardless or 1px border flat cards.

editor.layout: Full height (h-screen) with a fixed right panel for components and left panel for settings/properties. Central iframe/canvas area.
editor.canvas: bg-slate-100 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-inner my-4 mx-4 flex-1

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Glassmorphism for sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-white/20). Dashboards use crisp 1px borders with subtle shadows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hover states use layered soft ambient shadows (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]).

motion.hover: Subtle transform (-translate-y-1) for template cards and buttons.
motion.transitions: transition-transform duration-200 ease-out, transition-colors duration-200. NEVER use 'transition-all'.
motion.interactions: Use framer-motion for smooth sidebar toggling and component drag-and-drop feedback.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against #0A2540 is pure white. Use APCA contrast principles.
accessibility.rtl: CRITICAL: The entire application must be perfectly functional in RTL. Use HTML 'dir=rtl'. Use Tailwind logical properties (ps-, pe-, ms-, me-, text-start, text-end, border-s, border-e).

libraries.icons: lucide-react (use for simple icons), @phosphor-icons/react (for dashboard icons)
libraries.components: shadcn/ui (heavily customized for RTL and brand colors)

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Add `<html dir="rtl" lang="ar">` in index.html to enable RTL support.
Add Google Fonts import for Tajawal and Cairo in index.css.
Use Tailwind logical properties STRICTLY. Use `ps-` instead of `pl-`, `me-` instead of `mr-`, `text-start` instead of `text-left`. This ensures the UI flips correctly.
Do NOT use HTML input type date. Use shadcn calendar.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, modals, or sticky headers. Always apply solid or blurred backgrounds.
For the website builder canvas, build a drag-and-drop or click-to-add interface using state to manage sections (Hero, Text, Features, Gallery, Services, Testimonials, FAQ, Contact, Footer).
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="login-button"`).
Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transitions (e.g., 'transition-colors transition-transform').
Build standard Marketing pages: Home, Templates, Pricing, Domain Search, Contact, etc.
Build User Dashboard: Site management, domains, subscription, invoices.
Build Platform Admin Dashboard: Stats, customers, plans, CMS settings.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp buttons. Every interaction needs micro-animations. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use sonner for toasts.
